primer: AXISCADES Technologies is pivoting via a ~₹2,256 crore Akkodis sale into Defence Electronics, Aerospace, ESAI, and Space [8][10]. Retained H1 FY27 revenue grew 55% YoY on Mistral Solutions defence IP [8]. Still, price-blind forensics assign CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL on -₹135 crore FY26 FCF, 130 debtor days, and ₹698 crore Sep 2026 debt [1]. Three-year ROE sits at 10.8%, promoters sold 13.21% in 2026, and the OHLCV ledger shows Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) [1][12]. At ₹1,914.40 (₹8,189 Cr cap, 41.9x FY27E EBITDA vs ₹1,770 Base SOTP), new capital is REJECTED for COFORGE (40%), ASTRAMICRO (0% / DEFER), and CASH (60%).
